name: Stack
description: Vertical flow with a fixed gap between children. Works with inline children (links, spans) too. The default way to space components vertically.

values.name: sm
values.description: Tight spacing (0.5rem), e.g. form-field internals or list items.

values.name: lg
values.description: Loose spacing (2rem), e.g. between page blocks.

use: Nest stacks with different gaps to build rhythm.
avoid: Adding margins to children to fix spacing; change the stack modifier instead.
